description: Creates and starts a new evaluation run in Azure AI Foundry. Evaluators measure response quality dimensions such as coherence, relevance, groundedness, and fluency. Supply either (agentId + threadId) for agent-based evaluation or (datasetName + datasetVersion) for dataset-based evaluation.
note: Use GET /api/evaluators to list available evaluator names and IDs.

payload.description: Automatically evaluates agent responses for coherence after every completed response

manualTriggerPayload.description: Manually triggered relevance evaluation for audit purposes
